art_direction: Original late-1990s military support aircraft; dark grounded aerospace forms with restrained identification accents.
animation: Four held perceptual frames per craft for engine compression and navigation-light cadence.
layering: Aircraft bodies are authored sprites; tanker hose, drogue, progress UI, gunship fire and target effects remain independent animated gameplay layers.
provenance: Manually constructed EVAVO production pixel art; no proprietary source material.
